desc: Built with versatility in mind the Athlon Helos is a hunting scope designed with generations of hunting experience. The variable power gives the ability hunt game in the close Texas brush or on the wide open plains providing limitless versatility and with the first focal plane the holder over is the same at any magnification. Its multi-coated lenses offer better light transmission and clarity at dawn and dusk the time when most game is taken. Athlon scopes are constructed from a one piece tube for durability and dependability. Their fog proof, water proof and Argon purged design ensures that no matter the elements your scope stays crystal clear. For versatility and value the Athlon optics cannot be beat, offering everything the modern hunter needs in a rifle scope.
